text.es: Marta: Sé que puede parecer una locura, pero si pudiese ser, ¿tú querrías ser madre conmigo? Fina: Mi amor, si pudiese ser, me encantaría ser madre contigo.
text.en: Marta: I know it might sound crazy, but if it were possible, would you want to be a mother with me? Fina: My love, if it were possible, I would love to be a mother with you.
